answer: The ocean of anonymous peers is split from a fixed set of oasis relay nodes that alone carry paid traffic, and relay admission runs through groves: clusters of k established members who co-sign each entry and post shared bonds. Each identity costs one entry fee, and every grove member's bond is slashed if an admit cheats, so N puppets cost N fees plus repeated guarantor exposure per puppet; sponsorship slots per epoch are fixed, so no bulk discount exists. Relay throughput is quota-fixed and cannot be reset or split, keeping sybil growth linear in non-amortizable cost.
